21:1: Surat Al-Anbiya It is Meccan Al-Bukhari said: Muhammad bin Bashar told us, Ghundar told us, Shu’bah told us, on the authority of Abu Ishaq, I heard Abd al-Rahman bin Yazid, on the authority of Abdullah, who said: The Children of Israel, the Cave, Maryam, Taha, and the Prophets are among the first of the freed ones and they are among my descendants. In the name of God, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful This is a warning from God the Almighty that the Hour is approaching and near, and that people are heedless of it, meaning they do not work for it or prepare for it. Al-Nasa’i said: Ahmad bin Nasr told us, Hisham bin Abdul Malik Abu Al-Walid At-Tayalisi told us, Abu Mu’awiyah told us, Al-A’mash told us, on the authority of Abu Salih, on the authority of Abu Sa’id, on the authority of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace: They turn away in heedlessness. He said: In this world. And God the Almighty said: The command of God has come, so do not hasten it. And He said: “The Hour has drawn near, and the moon has split. And if they see a sign, they turn away.” Al-Hafiz Ibn Asakir narrated in the biography of Al-Hasan bin Hani’ Abu Nuwas the poet that he said: The most poetic of people is Sheikh At-Tahir Abu Al-Atahiya when he says: People are in their heedlessness and the millstone of death is grinding It was said to him: Where did you get this from? He said: From the saying of God the Most High: The reckoning of the people has drawn near, while they are in heedlessness turning away. It was narrated in the biography of Aamer bin Rabi’ah on the authority of Musa bin Ubaid Al-Amidi on the authority of Abd Al-Rahman bin Zaid bin Aslam on the authority of his father on the authority of Aamer bin Rabi’ah that an Arab man stayed with him, so Aamer honored his stay and spoke to the Messenger of God (peace and blessings of God be upon him) about him. Then the man came to him and said: I have taken a valley from the Messenger of God (peace and blessings of God be upon him) in the Arabs, and I wanted to cut off a piece of it for you to have and for your descendants after you. Aamer said: I have no need of your cutting off. Today a surah was revealed that has made us forget the world: The reckoning of the people has drawn near, while they are in heedlessness turning away. Then the Almighty informed us that they do not listen to the revelation that God sent down to His Messenger and the address to the Quraysh and those who were like them from the disbelievers, so He said, There comes to them no new message from their Lord, meaning that it was newly sent down, but they listen to it while they are playing, as Ibn Abbas said: What is the matter with you that you ask the People of the Book about what is in their hands when they have distorted it, changed it, added to it, and subtracted from it, while your Book is the most recent Book by God, and you read it pure and unmixed. Al-Bukhari narrated it in a similar manner. And His statement: And those who did wrong whispered secretly meaning, they said among themselves secretly, Is this not a human being like you? They meant the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, they ruled out that he was a prophet because he was a human being like them, so how could he be the only one to receive revelation without them? For this reason, He said: Then do you practice magic while you see? meaning, do you follow it and be like someone who practices magic while he knows that it is magic? So God, the Most High, answered them about what they invented and fabricated of lies: He said, 'My Lord knows what is said in the heaven and the earth.' meaning, the One who knows that, nothing is hidden from Him, and He is the One who sent down this Qur'an, which includes the report of the first and the last, and no one can produce the like of it except the One who knows the secret in the heavens and the earth. And His statement: And He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing meaning, the One who hears your words and the One who knows your conditions, and in this there is a threat and warning to them. And His statement: “Rather, they said, ‘It is just confused dreams. Rather, he invented it.’” This is a report of the stubbornness of the disbelievers, their heresy, and their differences in what they describe the Qur’an with, and their confusion about it and their deviation from it. Sometimes they make it magic, sometimes they make it poetry, sometimes they make it confused dreams, and sometimes they make it fabricated, as He said: See how they strike for you examples, so they have gone astray and cannot find a way. And His statement: Then let him bring us a sign just as the former ones were sent. They mean the she-camel of Salih and the signs of Moses and Jesus. And God said: And nothing prevented Us from sending signs except that the former ones denied them. And for this reason God Almighty said: “No city believed before them which We destroyed. So will they believe?” That is, We did not give a city from the cities in which the messengers were sent a sign through the hands of its prophet and they believed in it. Rather, they denied it, so We destroyed them because of that. So will these people believe in the signs if they saw them and not those? No, rather, Indeed, those upon whom the word of your Lord has come into effect will not believe, even if every sign should come to them, until they see the painful punishment. All of this is despite the fact that they witnessed dazzling signs, decisive arguments, and clear evidence at the hands of the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, which were more evident, clearer, dazzling, conclusive, and overwhelming than what was seen with any other prophet, may God bless them and grant them peace. Ibn Abi Hatim, may God have mercy on him, said: It was mentioned on the authority of Zaid bin Al-Habbab, Ibn Lahi’ah told us: Al-Harith bin Yazid Al-Hadrami told us on the authority of Ali bin Rabah Al-Lakhmi, who witnessed Ubadah bin As-Samit, saying: We were in the mosque with Abu Bakr As-Siddiq, may God be pleased with him, reciting the Qur’an to one another, then Abdullah bin Ubayy bin Salul came with a cushion and a carpet, so he put it down and leaned on it, and he was a handsome, eloquent, and argumentative man, so he said: O Abu Bakr, say Muhammad brings us a sign as the first ones did, Moses came with the tablets, David came with the Psalms, Salih came with the she-camel, and Jesus came with the Gospel and the Table, so Abu Bakr, may God be pleased with him, wept, so the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, went out, so Abu Bakr said: Let us go to the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, so that we may seek help from this hypocrite, so the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: He will not be made to stand for me, he will be made to stand for God Almighty. So we said: O Messenger of God, we have suffered from this hypocrite, so he said: Gabriel said: “I will go out and tell of the blessings of God which He has bestowed upon you, and His virtue by which He has favored you. He has given me the good report that I have been sent to the red and the black, and He has commanded me to warn the jinn, and He has given me His Book while I am illiterate, and He has forgiven my sins, past and future, and He has mentioned my name in the call to prayer, and He has provided me with the angels, and He has given me victory, and He has placed terror before me, and He has given me Al-Kawthar, and He has made my pool one of the most frequented pools on the Day of Resurrection, and He has promised me the praised station while the people are rushing with their heads covered, and He has made me in the first group to come out of the people, and He has admitted seventy thousand of my nation into Paradise through my intercession without reckoning, and He has given me authority and dominion, and He has made me in the highest room in Paradise in the Gardens of Bliss, and there is no one above me except the angels who carry the Throne, and He has made spoils permissible for me and my nation, and they were not permissible for anyone before us.” This hadith is very strange.

And if they see a sign, they turn away" the verse, and Al-Hafiz Ibn Asakir narrated in the biography of Al-Hasan bin Hani Abu Nuwas the poet that he said: The most poetic of people is Sheikh Al-Tahir Abu Al-Atahiya when he says: People are in their heedlessness and the millstone of death is grinding It was said to him: Where did you get this from? He said: From the saying of God the Most High: The reckoning of the people has drawn near, while they are in heedlessness turning away. It was narrated in the biography of Aamer bin Rabi’ah on the authority of Musa bin Ubaid Al-Amidi on the authority of Abd Al-Rahman bin Zaid bin Aslam on the authority of his father on the authority of Aamer bin Rabi’ah that an Arab man stayed with him, so Aamer honored his stay and spoke to the Messenger of God (peace and blessings of God be upon him) about him. Then the man came to him and said: I have taken a valley from the Messenger of God (peace and blessings of God be upon him) in the Arabs, and I wanted to cut off a piece of it for you to have and for your descendants after you. Aamer said: I have no need of your cutting off. Today a surah was revealed that has made us forget the world: The reckoning of the people has drawn near, while they are in heedlessness turning away. Then the Almighty informed us that they do not listen to the revelation that God sent down to His Messenger and the address to the Quraysh and those who were like them from the disbelievers, so He said, There comes to them no new message from their Lord, meaning that it was newly sent down, but they listen to it while they are playing, as Ibn Abbas said: What is the matter with you that you ask the People of the Book about what is in their hands when they have distorted it, changed it, added to it, and subtracted from it, while your Book is the most recent Book by God, and you read it pure and unmixed. Al-Bukhari narrated it in a similar manner. And His statement: And those who did wrong whispered secretly meaning, they said among themselves secretly, Is this not a human being like you? They meant the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, they ruled out that he was a prophet because he was a human being like them, so how could he be the only one to receive revelation without them? For this reason, He said: Then do you practice magic while you see? meaning, do you follow it and be like someone who practices magic while he knows that it is magic? So God, the Most High, answered them about what they invented and fabricated of lies: He said, 'My Lord knows what is said in the heaven and the earth.' meaning, the One who knows that, nothing is hidden from Him, and He is the One who sent down this Qur'an, which includes the report of the first and the last, and no one can produce the like of it except the One who knows the secret in the heavens and the earth. And His statement: And He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing meaning, the One who hears your words and the One who knows your conditions, and in this there is a threat and warning to them. And His statement: “Rather, they said, ‘It is just confused dreams. Rather, he invented it.’” This is a report of the stubbornness of the disbelievers, their heresy, and their differences in what they describe the Qur’an with, and their confusion about it and their deviation from it. Sometimes they make it magic, sometimes they make it poetry, sometimes they make it confused dreams, and sometimes they make it fabricated, as He said: See how they strike for you examples, so they have gone astray and cannot find a way. And His statement: Then let him bring us a sign just as the former ones were sent. They mean the she-camel of Salih and the signs of Moses and Jesus. And God said: And nothing prevented Us from sending signs except that the former ones denied them. And for this reason God Almighty said: “No city believed before them which We destroyed. So will they believe?” That is, We did not give a city from the cities in which the messengers were sent a sign through the hands of its prophet and they believed in it. Rather, they denied it, so We destroyed them because of that. So will these people believe in the signs if they saw them and not those? No, rather, Indeed, those upon whom the word of your Lord has come into effect will not believe, even if every sign should come to them, until they see the painful punishment. All of this is despite the fact that they witnessed dazzling signs, decisive arguments, and clear evidence at the hands of the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, which were more evident, clearer, dazzling, conclusive, and overwhelming than what was seen with any other prophet, may God bless them and grant them peace. Ibn Abi Hatim, may God have mercy on him, said: It was mentioned on the authority of Zaid bin Al-Habbab, Ibn Lahi’ah told us: Al-Harith bin Yazid Al-Hadrami told us on the authority of Ali bin Rabah Al-Lakhmi, who witnessed Ubadah bin As-Samit, saying: We were in the mosque with Abu Bakr As-Siddiq, may God be pleased with him, reciting the Qur’an to one another, then Abdullah bin Ubayy bin Salul came with a cushion and a carpet, so he put it down and leaned on it, and he was a handsome, eloquent, and argumentative man, so he said: O Abu Bakr, say Muhammad brings us a sign as the first ones did, Moses came with the tablets, David came with the Psalms, Salih came with the she-camel, and Jesus came with the Gospel and the Table, so Abu Bakr, may God be pleased with him, wept, so the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, went out, so Abu Bakr said: Let us go to the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, so that we may seek help from this hypocrite, so the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: He will not be made to stand for me, he will be made to stand for God Almighty. So we said: O Messenger of God, we have suffered from this hypocrite, so he said: Gabriel said: “I will go out and tell of the blessings of God which He has bestowed upon you, and His virtue by which He has favored you. He has given me the good report that I have been sent to the red and the black, and He has commanded me to warn the jinn, and He has given me His Book while I am illiterate, and He has forgiven my sins, past and future, and He has mentioned my name in the call to prayer, and He has provided me with the angels, and He has given me victory, and He has placed terror before me, and He has given me Al-Kawthar, and He has made my pool one of the most frequented pools on the Day of Resurrection, and He has promised me the praised station while the people are rushing with their heads covered, and He has made me in the first group to come out of the people, and He has admitted seventy thousand of my nation into Paradise through my intercession without reckoning, and He has given me authority and dominion, and He has made me in the highest room in Paradise in the Gardens of Bliss, and there is no one above me except the angels who carry the Throne, and He has made spoils permissible for me and my nation, and they were not permissible for anyone before us.” This hadith is very strange.

21:7: God Almighty says in response to those who denied the mission of messengers from among humans: And We did not send before you, except men to whom We revealed meaning that all the messengers who came before were men from among humans, and there were no angels among them, as He said in the other verse: And We did not send before you, except men to whom We revealed, so ask the people of the message and God Almighty said: Say, 'I am not an innovation among the messengers' and God Almighty said, narrating what came before from the nations, because they denied that and said, Are human beings guiding us? That is why God Almighty said: So ask the people of the message if you do not know meaning ask the people of knowledge from the nations such as the Jews, Christians and other sects: Were the messengers who came to them human beings or angels? Rather, they were human beings, and that is from the completion of God's blessing upon His creation, as He sent among them messengers from among themselves who were able to receive the message from them and take from them. And His statement: And We did not make them bodies that do not eat food means, rather, they were bodies that ate food, as God Almighty said: And We did not send before you any messengers except that they ate food and walked in the markets meaning, they were human beings among humans who ate and drank like people, and they entered the markets to earn money and trade, and that did not harm them nor did it diminish anything from them, as the polytheists imagined in their saying, “What is this Messenger, that he eats food and walks in the markets? Why was not an angel sent down to him to be a warner with him? Or a treasure thrown down to him, or he had a garden from which he could eat?” The verse. And His statement: And they were not immortal meaning in this world, rather they lived and then died. And We did not grant to any human being before you immortality and their special characteristic is that revelation comes to them from God Almighty, the angels descend upon them from God with what He decrees in His creation, what He commands and what He forbids. And His statement: Then We fulfilled for them the promise meaning that what their Lord promised them to destroy the wrongdoers, God fulfilled for them His promise and did that, and for this reason He said So We saved them and whom We willed meaning their followers from the believers and We destroyed the transgressors meaning those who denied what the messengers brought.

21:10: God the Almighty says, drawing attention to the honor of the Qur’an and urging them to recognize its value: Indeed, We have sent down to you a Book in which is your remembrance. Ibn Abbas said: Your honor. Mujahid said: Your speech. Al-Hasan said: Your religion. Do you not then understand? meaning this blessing, and accept it, as God the Almighty said: And indeed, it is a reminder for you and your people, and you will be questioned. And His statement: And how many a city have We destroyed which was unjust. This is a formula of multiplication, as He said: And how many generations have We destroyed after Noah. And God the Almighty said: How many a city have We destroyed while it was unjust, so it is desolate on its roofs. The verse. And His statement, And We brought forth after them another people, meaning another nation after them, But when they perceived Our might, meaning they were certain that the punishment would inevitably befall them as their prophet had promised them, at once they were running from it, meaning they were fleeing, escaping. Do not run, but return to your luxurious life and your dwellings, this was a slight mockery of them, meaning they were told slightly, Do not run, fleeing from the punishment coming down, and return to the blessings, joy, life, and good dwellings you were in. Qatada said, mocking them, Perhaps you will be questioned, meaning about what you were doing in terms of giving thanks for the blessings. They said, ‘Woe to us! Indeed, we were wrongdoers,’ they confessed their sins when that would not benefit them. And that was their cry until We made them a harvest, extinguished, meaning that that statement, which was the confession of injustice, continued to haunt them until We harvested them, and their movements and voices were completely extinguished.

21:16: God Almighty tells us that He created the heavens and the earth with truth, that is, with justice and equity, That He may reward those who do evil for what they have done and reward those who do good with goodness, and that He did not create that in vain or play, as He said: "And We did not create the heaven and the earth and all that is between them in vain. 21:21: The Almighty denies those who take gods other than Him, saying: Or have they taken gods from the earth who resurrect? That is, do they revive the dead and resurrect them from the earth, that is, they are not able to do any of that, so how did they make them a rival to God and worship them along with Him? Then the Almighty informed that if there were gods in existence other than Him, the heavens and the earth would have been corrupted, so He said: If there were gods within them that is, in the heavens and the earth, they would have been corrupted as the Almighty said: "God has not taken a son, nor was there any god with Him. Then each god would have taken what he created, and some of them would have sought to overcome others. Glory be to God, Lord of the Throne, above what they describe." And He said here: So glory be to God, Lord of the Throne, above what they describe that is, above what they say that He has a son or a partner. Glory be to Him, Most High, Most Holy, and Most Exalted, far above what they invent and fabricate, a great exaltation. And His statement, He is not questioned about what He does, but they will be questioned, meaning He is the Ruler whose judgment cannot be questioned, and no one can object to Him due to His greatness, majesty, pride, work, wisdom, justice, and kindness. And they will be questioned, meaning He will question His creation about what they do, as in His statement, By your Lord, We will surely question them all * About what they used to do. This is like the statement of the Most High, And He protects, but no one protects against Him.

21:24: God the Almighty says: "Or have they taken other gods besides Him? Say O Muhammad, Bring your proof" meaning your evidence for what you say. "This is the message of those with me meaning the Qur'an and the message of those before me" meaning the previous books, contrary to what you say and claim. Every book that was sent down to every prophet speaks that there is no god but God, but you, O polytheists, do not act according to the truth, so you turn away from it. For this reason, He said: "And We did not send before you any messenger except that We revealed to him that there is no god but Me, so worship Me" as He said: "And ask those We sent before you of Our messengers, did We appoint other than the Most Merciful gods to be worshipped?" And He said: "And We have certainly sent among every nation a messenger, [saying], 'Worship God and avoid false deities'" so every prophet that God sent calls to the worship of God alone, with no partner for Him, and the innate nature bears witness to that as well. The polytheists have no proof, and their argument is invalid before their Lord, and upon them is wrath, and for them is a severe punishment.

21:26: God Almighty says in response to those who claim that He, the Most High and Holy, has a son from the angels, like those who said that among the Arabs: The angels are the daughters of God, so He said: Glory be to Him! Rather, they are honored servants. That is, the angels are God’s servants, honored by Him in high stations and sublime positions, and they are extremely obedient to Him in word and deed. They do not precede Him in speech, and they act by His command. That is, they do not precede Him in any command, nor do they disobey Him in what He commands them to do, rather they hasten to do it, and He, the Most High, has knowledge that encompasses them, so nothing about them is hidden from Him. He knows what is before them and what is behind them. And His statement: And they do not intercede except for him with whom He is pleased is like His statement: Who is he that can intercede with Him except by His permission? And His statement: And intercession does not avail with Him except for him whom He permits is in many verses with the same meaning. And they are fearful for fear of Him meaning for fear and dread of Him “and whoever among them says, ‘I am a god besides Him’ - We will recompense him with Hell. Thus do We recompense the wrongdoers” meaning everyone who says that, and this is a condition, and a condition does not necessarily occur, like His statement: Say, ‘If the Most Merciful had a son, then I would be the first of his worshippers’ and His statement: If you associate others with Me, your work will surely become worthless, and you will surely be among the losers.

For this reason He said: And We made from water every living thing, will they not then believe? meaning that they see the creations happening little by little, clearly, and all of this is evidence of the existence of the Creator, the Doer, the Chosen One, the Able to do whatever He wills. In everything there is a sign that indicates that He is One. Sufyan al-Thawri said on the authority of his father on the authority of Ikrimah who said: Ibn Abbas was asked: Was the night before or the day? He said: Have you seen the heavens and the earth when they were joined? Was there between them anything but darkness? That is so that you may know that the night came before the day. Ibn Abi Hatim said: My father told us, Ibrahim ibn Hamza told us, Hatim told us on the authority of Hamza ibn Abi Muhammad, on the authority of Abdullah ibn Dinar on the authority of Ibn Umar that a man came to him asking him about the heavens and the earth: They were joined together and then We split them. He said: Go to that Sheikh and ask him, then come back and tell me what he said to you. He said: So he went to Ibn Abbas and asked him. Ibn Abbas said: Yes, the heavens were sealed and did not rain, and the earth was sealed and did not produce vegetation. Then when He created the inhabitants of the earth, He split this one with rain and split that one with vegetation. So the man went back to Ibn Omar and told him. Ibn Omar said: Now I know that Ibn Abbas has been given knowledge of the Qur’an. He spoke the truth. That is how it was. Ibn Omar said: I used to say that I did not like the audacity of Ibn Abbas in interpreting the Qur’an, but now I know that he has been given knowledge of the Qur’an. Atiyah Al-Awfi said: This was sealed and did not rain, so it rained, and this was sealed and did not produce vegetation, so it produced vegetation. Ismail bin Abi Khalid said: I asked Abu Saleh Al-Hanafi about his statement: The heavens and the earth were joined together, then We parted them. He said: The heaven was one, then He parted from it seven heavens, and the earth was one, then He parted from it seven earths. Mujahid said the same, and he added: The heaven and the earth were not in contact. Saeed bin Jubair said: Rather, the heaven and the earth were joined together, then when He raised the heaven and brought forth the earth from it, that was their parting that God mentioned in His Book. Al-Hasan and Qatadah said: They were together, then He separated them with this air. And His statement: And We made from water every living thing meaning the origin of all living things. Ibn Abi Hatim said: My father told us, Abu al-Jamahir told us, Saeed bin Bashir told us, Qatada told us on the authority of Abu Maymunah on the authority of Abu Hurayrah that he said: “O Prophet of God, when I see you, my eyes are cooled and my soul is at peace, so tell us about everything.” He said: Everything was created from water. Imam Ahmad said: Yazid told us, Hammam told us, on the authority of Qatadah, on the authority of Abu Maimouna, on the authority of Abu Hurairah, who said: “I said, ‘O Messenger of God, when I see you, my soul is at peace and my eyes are comforted. So tell me about everything.’ He said, ‘Everything was created from water.’ I said, ‘Tell me about something that if I do it, I will enter Paradise.’ He said, ‘Spread peace, feed the poor, maintain ties with relatives, and stand at night while people are asleep, then enter Paradise in peace.’” It was also narrated by Abd al-Samad, Affan, and Bahz on the authority of Hammam. Ahmad was the only one to narrate it. This chain of transmission meets the criteria of the two Sahihs, except that Abu Maimouna is one of the men of the Sunan and his name is Salim, and al-Tirmidhi classed it as saheeh. Saeed ibn Abi ‘Arooba narrated it on the authority of Qatadah as a mursal, and God knows best. And His statement: And We placed on the earth firm mountains means mountains with which He anchored the earth and made it firm and weighed it down so that it would not shake with the people, meaning that it would not be disturbed and moved, so that they would not be stable on it because it is submerged in water except for a quarter of an inch. It is exposed to the air and the sun so that its people may see the sky and what is in it of dazzling signs, wisdom and evidence. For this reason He said: lest it shake with them meaning so that it would not shake with them. And His statement: And We placed therein paths as roads means gaps in the mountains so that they may take a path from one country to another and from one region to another, as is seen on the earth, where the mountain is a barrier between these lands and those lands, so God makes a gap in it so that the people may take it from here to there. For this reason He said: Perhaps they will be guided. And His statement: And We have made the sky a protected ceiling meaning over the earth and it is like a dome over it, as He said: And the sky We constructed with power, and indeed, We are expanding it. And He said: And the sky and He who constructed it “Have they not looked at the sky above them, how We constructed it and adorned it and how there are no rifts in it?” And construction is the erection of the dome, as the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: Islam was built on five meaning five pillars, and this only occurs in tents as the Arabs knew it protected meaning high and protected from being reached. Mujahid said: It is raised. Ibn Abi Hatim said: Ali bin Al-Hussein told us, Ahmad bin Abdul Rahman Al-Dashtaki told us, my father told me on the authority of his father on the authority of Ash’ath meaning Ibn Ishaq Al-Qummi on the authority of Ja’far bin Abi Al-Mughira on the authority of Sa’id bin Jubayr on the authority of Ibn Abbas, a man said: O Messenger of God, what is this sky? He said: A wave held back from you.” Its chain of transmission is strange. And His statement: And they turn away from its signs is like His statement: And how many a sign is there in the heavens and the earth which they pass by while they are turning away from it meaning they do not contemplate what God has created in it of great vastness and dazzling height, and what it has been adorned with of fixed and moving planets in its night and day, such as this sun that cuts through the entire celestial sphere in a day and a night, so it travels a distance whose extent is known only to God who has determined it, subjected it and directed it. Ibn Abi Al-Dunya, may God have mercy on him, mentioned in his book At-Tafkur wa’l-I’tibar: that some of the worshippers of the Children of Israel worshipped for thirty years, and if a man among them worshipped for thirty years, a cloud would shade him, so that man did not see anything of what others were experiencing, so he complained about that to his mother, so she said to him: O my son, perhaps you have sinned during this period of your worship? He said: No, by God, I do not know. She said: Perhaps you thought about it? He said: No, nor did I think about it. She said: Perhaps you raised your gaze to the sky and then looked back without thinking? He said: Yes, a lot. She said: So from here you came. Then he said, pointing out some of His signs: And it is He who created the night and the day, meaning this in its darkness and stillness and this in its light and companionship. One is long sometimes and then short at other times, and the other is the opposite. And the sun and the moon, these have a light of their own and an orbit of their own and a time of their own and a movement and a specific course, and this has another light and another orbit and another course and another estimation. And each floats in an orbit, meaning they revolve. Ibn Abbas said: They revolve as the spindle revolves in the sphere. Mujahid said: The spindle does not revolve except with the sphere, and the sphere does not revolve except with the spindle. Likewise the stars, the sun, and the moon do not revolve except with Him and He does not revolve except with them, as God Almighty said: “And He who splits the dawn and made the night for rest and the sun and the moon for reckoning. That is the determination of the Almighty, the Knowing.”

For this reason He said: And We made from water every living thing, will they not then believe? meaning that they see the creations happening little by little, clearly, and all of this is evidence of the existence of the Creator, the Doer, the Chosen One, the Able to do whatever He wills. In everything there is a sign that indicates that He is One. Sufyan al-Thawri said on the authority of his father on the authority of Ikrimah who said: Ibn Abbas was asked: Was the night before or the day? He said: Have you seen the heavens and the earth when they were joined? Was there between them anything but darkness? That is so that you may know that the night came before the day. Ibn Abi Hatim said: My father told us, Ibrahim ibn Hamza told us, Hatim told us on the authority of Hamza ibn Abi Muhammad, on the authority of Abdullah ibn Dinar on the authority of Ibn Umar that a man came to him asking him about the heavens and the earth: They were joined together and then We split them. He said: Go to that Sheikh and ask him, then come back and tell me what he said to you. He said: So he went to Ibn Abbas and asked him. Ibn Abbas said: Yes, the heavens were sealed and did not rain, and the earth was sealed and did not produce vegetation. Then when He created the inhabitants of the earth, He split this one with rain and split that one with vegetation. So the man went back to Ibn Omar and told him. Ibn Omar said: Now I know that Ibn Abbas has been given knowledge of the Qur’an. He spoke the truth. That is how it was. Ibn Omar said: I used to say that I did not like the audacity of Ibn Abbas in interpreting the Qur’an, but now I know that he has been given knowledge of the Qur’an. Atiyah Al-Awfi said: This was sealed and did not rain, so it rained, and this was sealed and did not produce vegetation, so it produced vegetation. Ismail bin Abi Khalid said: I asked Abu Saleh Al-Hanafi about his statement: The heavens and the earth were joined together, then We parted them. He said: The heaven was one, then He parted from it seven heavens, and the earth was one, then He parted from it seven earths. Mujahid said the same, and he added: The heaven and the earth were not in contact. Saeed bin Jubair said: Rather, the heaven and the earth were joined together, then when He raised the heaven and brought forth the earth from it, that was their parting that God mentioned in His Book. Al-Hasan and Qatadah said: They were together, then He separated them with this air. And His statement: And We made from water every living thing meaning the origin of all living things. Ibn Abi Hatim said: My father told us, Abu al-Jamahir told us, Saeed bin Bashir told us, Qatada told us on the authority of Abu Maymunah on the authority of Abu Hurayrah that he said: “O Prophet of God, when I see you, my eyes are cooled and my soul is at peace, so tell us about everything.” He said: Everything was created from water. Imam Ahmad said: Yazid told us, Hammam told us, on the authority of Qatadah, on the authority of Abu Maimouna, on the authority of Abu Hurairah, who said: “I said, ‘O Messenger of God, when I see you, my soul is at peace and my eyes are comforted. So tell me about everything.’ He said, ‘Everything was created from water.’ I said, ‘Tell me about something that if I do it, I will enter Paradise.’ He said, ‘Spread peace, feed the poor, maintain ties with relatives, and stand at night while people are asleep, then enter Paradise in peace.’” It was also narrated by Abd al-Samad, Affan, and Bahz on the authority of Hammam. Ahmad was the only one to narrate it. This chain of transmission meets the criteria of the two Sahihs, except that Abu Maimouna is one of the men of the Sunan and his name is Salim, and al-Tirmidhi classed it as saheeh. Saeed ibn Abi ‘Arooba narrated it on the authority of Qatadah as a mursal, and God knows best. And His statement: And We placed on the earth firm mountains means mountains with which He anchored the earth and made it firm and weighed it down so that it would not shake with the people, meaning that it would not be disturbed and moved, so that they would not be stable on it because it is submerged in water except for a quarter of an inch. It is exposed to the air and the sun so that its people may see the sky and what is in it of dazzling signs, wisdom and evidence. For this reason He said: lest it shake with them meaning so that it would not shake with them. And His statement: And We placed therein paths as roads means gaps in the mountains so that they may take a path from one country to another and from one region to another, as is seen on the earth, where the mountain is a barrier between these lands and those lands, so God makes a gap in it so that the people may take it from here to there. For this reason He said: Perhaps they will be guided. And His statement: And We have made the sky a protected ceiling meaning over the earth and it is like a dome over it, as He said: And the sky We constructed with power, and indeed, We are expanding it. And He said: And the sky and He who constructed it “Have they not looked at the sky above them, how We constructed it and adorned it and how there are no rifts in it?” And construction is the erection of the dome, as the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: Islam was built on five meaning five pillars, and this only occurs in tents as the Arabs knew it protected meaning high and protected from being reached. Mujahid said: It is raised. Ibn Abi Hatim said: Ali bin Al-Hussein told us, Ahmad bin Abdul Rahman Al-Dashtaki told us, my father told me on the authority of his father on the authority of Ash’ath meaning Ibn Ishaq Al-Qummi on the authority of Ja’far bin Abi Al-Mughira on the authority of Sa’id bin Jubayr on the authority of Ibn Abbas, a man said: O Messenger of God, what is this sky? He said: A wave held back from you.” Its chain of transmission is strange. And His statement: And they turn away from its signs is like His statement: And how many a sign is there in the heavens and the earth which they pass by while they are turning away from it meaning they do not contemplate what God has created in it of great vastness and dazzling height, and what it has been adorned with of fixed and moving planets in its night and day, such as this sun that cuts through the entire celestial sphere in a day and a night, so it travels a distance whose extent is known only to God who has determined it, subjected it and directed it. Ibn Abi Al-Dunya, may God have mercy on him, mentioned in his book At-Tafkur wa’l-I’tibar: that some of the worshippers of the Children of Israel worshipped for thirty years, and if a man among them worshipped for thirty years, a cloud would shade him, so that man did not see anything of what others were experiencing, so he complained about that to his mother, so she said to him: O my son, perhaps you have sinned during this period of your worship? He said: No, by God, I do not know. She said: Perhaps you thought about it? He said: No, nor did I think about it. She said: Perhaps you raised your gaze to the sky and then looked back without thinking? He said: Yes, a lot. She said: So from here you came. Then he said, pointing out some of His signs: And it is He who created the night and the day, meaning this in its darkness and stillness and this in its light and companionship. One is long sometimes and then short at other times, and the other is the opposite. And the sun and the moon, these have a light of their own and an orbit of their own and a time of their own and a movement and a specific course, and this has another light and another orbit and another course and another estimation. And each floats in an orbit, meaning they revolve. Ibn Abbas said: They revolve as the spindle revolves in the sphere. Mujahid said: The spindle does not revolve except with the sphere, and the sphere does not revolve except with the spindle. Likewise the stars, the sun, and the moon do not revolve except with Him and He does not revolve except with them, as God Almighty said: “And He who splits the dawn and made the night for rest and the sun and the moon for reckoning. That is the determination of the Almighty, the Knowing.”
21:34: God the Almighty says: And We have not granted to any human being before you meaning O Muhammad immortality meaning in this world, rather Everything on it will perish, but the Face of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor, will remain. This noble verse has been used as evidence by some scholars who have said that Al-Khidr, peace be upon him, died and is not alive until now, because he was a human being, whether he was a saint, a prophet, or a messenger. God the Almighty has said: And We have not granted to any human being before you immortality. And His statement: If you die meaning O Muhammad are they the immortals meaning they hope to live after you, this will not happen, rather everyone will perish, and for this reason God the Almighty said: Every soul will taste death. It has been narrated from Al-Shafi'i, may God have mercy on him, that he recited and cited these two couplets: Men wished that I would die, and if I die, then I am not alone in that path. So tell the one who seeks something different from what happened: Prepare for another like it. It is as if he has already done so. And His statement: And We test you with evil and with good as trial means that We test you with calamities at times and with blessings at other times, so We see who is grateful and who is ungrateful, who is patient and who despairs, as Ali ibn Abi Talhah said on the authority of Ibn Abbas: And We test you means We afflict you with evil and with good as trial with hardship and ease, health and sickness, wealth and poverty, lawful and unlawful, obedience and disobedience, guidance and misguidance. And His statement: And to Us you will be returned means that We judge you with your deeds.

21:36: God Almighty says to His Prophet, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him, And when those who disbelieve see you, meaning the disbelievers of Quraysh, such as Abu Jahl and his likes, they take you only in ridicule, meaning they mock you and belittle you. They say, Is this the one who mentions your gods? meaning, is this the one who insults your gods and belittles your dreams? God Almighty says, And they are disbelievers in the mention of the Most Gracious, meaning they are disbelievers in God, and despite this they mock the Messenger of God, as He says in another verse, “And when they see you, they take you only in ridicule. Is this the one whom God has sent as a messenger? He almost led us astray from our gods had we not been patient toward them. And they will know when they see the punishment who is most astray in way.” And His saying: He created man in haste is as He said in the other verse: And man is ever hasty meaning in matters. Mujahid said: God created Adam after everything else, at the end of the day, on the day of the creation of creation. Then when the spirit revived his eyes, tongue, and head, and it had not yet reached his lower body, he said: O Lord, hasten my creation before sunset. And Ibn Abi Hatim said: Ahmad bin Sinan told us. Yazid bin Harun narrated to us, Muhammad bin Alqamah bin Waqqas Al-Laythi informed us, on the authority of Abu Salamah, on the authority of Abu Hurairah, who said: The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: “The best day on which the sun has risen is Friday. On it Adam was created, on it he was admitted to Paradise, on it he was sent down from it, on it the Hour will come, and on it there is an hour when no believer prays - and he held up his fingers, making it small - and asked God for something good except that He will give it to him.” Abu Salamah said: Abdullah bin Salam said: I know that hour, it is the last hours of the day on Friday, and it is the hour in which God created Adam. God the Most High said: “He created man from haste. I will show you My signs, so do not be impatient.” The wisdom in mentioning man’s haste here is that when He mentioned those who mocked the Messenger, may God bless him and grant him peace, the desire to take revenge on them occurred to people and they hastened that, so God the Most High said: He created man from haste, because God the Most High gives respite to the oppressor until He seizes him, He does not let him go. He postpones and then hastens, and He looks and then does not delay. That is why He said: I will show you My signs, meaning: My vengeance, judgment and power over those who disobey Me, so do not be impatient.

21:38: God the Almighty tells us about the polytheists that they also hasten the punishment to befall them, out of denial, ingratitude, disbelief, stubbornness and enslavement. He said, And they say, 'When will this promise come to pass, if you should be truthful?' God the Almighty said, If only those who disbelieve knew when they will not be able to avert the Fire from their faces or from their backs, meaning if they were certain that it would inevitably befall them, they would not hasten it. And if only they knew when the punishment will cover them from above them and from beneath their feet, They will have canopies of Fire above them and canopies beneath them, "They will have beds of Hell and over them coverings, and He said in this verse, When they will not be able to avert the Fire from their faces or from their backs, and He said, Their garments will be of pitch, and the Fire will cover their faces, so the punishment will surround them from all sides, nor will they be aided, meaning they will have no aid, as He said, And they will have no protector from God." And His saying: Rather, it will come upon them suddenly, meaning, it will come upon them suddenly, meaning, all of a sudden, and it will astonish them, meaning, it will frighten them, so they will surrender to it, confused and not knowing what to do, and they will not be able to repel it, meaning, they will have no way of doing so, nor will they be given respite, meaning, it will not be delayed from them for a single hour.

21:41: The Almighty says, comforting His Messenger for the harm that the polytheists had done him in terms of mockery and denial: And messengers before you were mocked, but that which they used to mock at encompassed those who mocked them. That is, the punishment that they had ruled out happening, as the Almighty said: “And messengers before you were denied, but they were patient over being denied and harmed until Our victory came to them. And there is no changing the words of God. And there has come to you some of the report of the messengers.” Then the Almighty mentioned His blessing upon His servants in His protection by night and day, and His guardianship and watch over them with His eye that never sleeps, so He said: Say, ‘Who guards you by night and by day from the Most Merciful?’ That is, instead of the Most Merciful, meaning someone other than Him, as the poet said: A slave girl who has never worn a thobe or tasted pistachios That is, you did not taste the pistachio instead of the legumes. And the Almighty’s saying: Rather, they turn away from the remembrance of their Lord meaning, they do not acknowledge the grace of God upon them and His kindness to them, rather they turn away from His signs and favors. Then He said: Or have they gods who can protect them other than Us? This is an interrogative of denial, rebuke and reproach, meaning, have they gods who can protect them and take care of them other than Us? The matter is not as they imagined, nor as they claimed. That is why He said: They cannot help themselves meaning that these gods whom they relied on other than God cannot help themselves. And His saying: Nor do they accompany Us Al-Awfi said on the authority of Ibn Abbas: Nor do they accompany Us meaning they are neighbors. Qatadah said: They do not wake up with good from God. Another said: Nor do they accompany Us or protect.

21:44: God the Almighty says, informing about the polytheists: What deceived them and led them to what they are in of misguidance is that they enjoyed the life of this world and were blessed and their life was long in what they were in, so they believed that they were on something. Then He said, admonishing them: Do they not see that We come to the land and reduce it from its borders? The commentators differed about its meaning, and we have mentioned it before in Surat Ar-Ra’d, and the best interpretation is the saying of God the Almighty: And We have destroyed the towns around you and have repeated the signs that perhaps they will return. Al-Hasan Al-Basri said: He means by that the emergence of Islam over disbelief, and the meaning is: Do they not take heed of God’s victory for His friends over His enemies and His destruction of the nations that denied and the unjust towns and His salvation of His believing servants? For this reason He said: Do they understand the victors? meaning rather they are the defeated, the lowest, the losers and the most contemptible. And His statement: Say, ‘I only warn you by revelation’ means, I am only conveying from God what I have warned you of of torment and punishment. This is nothing but what God has revealed to me. However, this is of no use to one whose insight God has blinded and whose hearing and heart have been sealed. For this reason, He said: And the deaf do not hear the call when they are warned. And His statement: And if a blast of the punishment of your Lord should touch them, they will surely say, ‘Woe to us! Indeed, we were wrongdoers.’ Meaning, if these deniers were touched by the slightest bit of God’s punishment, they would confess their sins and that they were wrongdoers to themselves in this world. And His statement: And We will set up the just scales for the Day of Resurrection, so no soul will be wronged at all. Meaning, We will set up the just scales for the Day of Resurrection. Most people agree that it is only one scale, but it is pluralized in consideration of the multiplicity of deeds weighed on it. And His statement: “So no soul will be wronged at all. Even if it is the weight of a mustard seed, We will bring it forth, and sufficient are We as reckoners.” Just as God Almighty said: And your Lord does not wrong anyone. And He said: “Indeed, God does not wrong by the weight of an atom. And if it is a good deed, He multiplies it and gives from Himself a great reward.” And Luqman said: “O my son, if it is the weight of a mustard seed and is in a rock or in the heavens or in the earth, God will bring it forth. Indeed, God is Subtle and Aware.” And in the two Sahihs on the authority of Abu Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: “Two words are light on the tongue, heavy on the scale, and beloved to the Most Merciful: Glory be to God and His praise, glory be to God the Almighty.” Imam Ahmad said: Ibrahim bin Ishaq al-Talaqani told us, Ibn al-Mubarak told us, on the authority of Laith bin Saad, on the authority of Aamer bin Yahya, on the authority of Abu Abd al-Rahman al-Habli, who said: I heard Abdullah bin Amr bin al-Aas say: The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: “God, the Almighty, will select a man from my nation in front of all creation on the Day of Resurrection, and will spread out ninety-nine scrolls for him, each scroll as far as the eye can see. Then He will say: Do you deny any of this? Did the guardians of my books wrong you? He will say: No, my Lord. He will say: Do you have an excuse or a good deed? He will say: The man will be astonished and will say: No, my Lord. He will say: Yes, you have one good deed with us, and you will not be wronged today. Then a card will be brought out for him, saying: I bear witness that there is no god but God, and I bear witness that Muhammad is the Messenger of God. He will say: Bring him. He will say: O Lord, is this card with these scrolls? He will say: You will not be wronged. He will say: The scrolls will be placed on one side of the scale and the card on the other side. He said: The scrolls will fly away and the card will be heavy. He said: Nothing is heavier than ‘In the name of God, the Most Gracious.’” The Most Merciful. Narrated by Al-Tirmidhi and Ibn Majah on the authority of Al-Layth bin Saad. Al-Tirmidhi said: Hasan Gharib. Imam Ahmad said: Qutaybah told us, Ibn Lahi’ah told us, on the authority of Amr ibn Yahya, on the authority of Abu Abd al-Rahman al-Habli, on the authority of Abdullah ibn Amr ibn al-‘As, who said: The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: “The scales will be placed on the Day of Resurrection, and a man will be brought and placed on one side of the scale, and what was counted against him will be placed in what tilts the scale. He said: Then he will be sent to the Fire. He said: Then when he turns away, a voice from the Most Merciful, the Almighty, will say: Do not be hasty, for there is still something left for him. 21:48: It has been previously mentioned that God the Almighty often links the mention of Moses and Muhammad, may God's prayers and peace be upon them, with their books, and for this reason He said: And We gave Moses and Aaron the Criterion Mujahid said: meaning the Book. Ibn Zayd said, meaning al-Nasr 110:the comprehensive statement in this is that the heavenly books include the distinction between truth and falsehood, guidance and misguidance, error and right guidance, lawful and unlawful, and what brings light to the hearts, guidance, fear, repentance and awe. For this reason He said: The Criterion and a light and a reminder for the righteous meaning a reminder and admonition to them, then He described them and said: Those who fear their Lord unseen like His saying: Whoever fears the Most Merciful unseen and comes with a heart turned in repentance. And His statement: Indeed, those who fear their Lord unseen will have forgiveness and a great reward. “And they are fearful of the Hour.” That is, fearful and apprehensive. Then the Most High said: And this is a blessed message which We have sent down. That is, the great Qur’an which falsehood cannot approach from before it or from behind it, a revelation from the Wise, the Praiseworthy. Then will you deny it? That is, will you deny it while it is extremely clear and evident?

21:51: The Almighty tells about His friend Abraham, peace be upon him, that He gave him his guidance before, meaning from his childhood He inspired him with the truth and the argument against his people, as the Almighty said: And that was Our argument which We gave Abraham against his people. And what is mentioned of the report about him in his father's bringing him into the flock while he was an infant, and that he went out after a few days and looked at the planet and the creatures and had insight into them, and what many of the commentators and others narrated, most of them are the hadiths of the Children of Israel, so whatever of them agrees with the truth, from what we have in our hands from the infallible one, we accept it because it agrees with the correct one, and whatever contradicts anything of that we reject, and whatever does not agree or contradict, we do not believe it nor disbelieve it, rather we make it a waqf, and whatever was of this type, many of the predecessors permitted its narration, and much of that is of no benefit and no result from which there is no benefit in the religion, and if its benefit were to return to those charged with their religion, this complete and comprehensive Sharia would have explained it, and what we follow in this interpretation is to ignore many of the Israelite hadiths Because it is a waste of time, and because many of them contain lies that are spread among them, they do not differentiate between the correct and the incorrect, as the imams, preservers, and masters of this nation have explained. What is meant here is that God Almighty informed us that He had given Abraham his guidance before, that is, before that. And his saying: And We were aware of it means that he was worthy of that. Then he said: “When he said to his father and his al-Nas 114:What are these statues to which you are devoted?” This is the guidance that he was given from his youth to denounce his people for worshipping idols instead of God Almighty, so he said: What are these statues to which you are devoted? meaning devoted to worshipping them. Ibn Abi Hatim said: Al-Hasan bin Muhammad Al-Sabah told us, Abu Muawiyah Al-Dharee’ told us, Saeed bin Tarif told us on the authority of Al-Asbagh bin Nabatah who said: Ali, may God be pleased with him, passed by some people playing chess, and he said: What are these statues to which you are devoted? It is better for one of you to touch a live coal until it is extinguished than to touch them? They said: We found our fathers worshipping them. They had no argument other than the misguided actions of their fathers, and for this reason he said: Indeed, you and your fathers were in manifest error. That is, speaking to your fathers, whose actions you used as an argument, is like speaking to you, so you and they are in error, not on the straight path. So when he belittled their dreams and led their fathers astray and despised their gods, “They said: Have you brought us the truth, or are you one of the players?” They said: Are you saying this speech that has come from you as a player or are you right in it? We have not heard it before you. “He said: Rather, your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, who created them.” That is, your Lord, there is no god but Him, and He is the One Who… He created the heavens and the earth and all that they contain of creatures, He began their creation, and He is the Creator of all things. And I am of the witnesses to that, meaning, I bear witness that there is no god but Him and no Lord but Him.

21:64: God Almighty says, informing about the people of Abraham when he said to them what he said, So they turned to themselves, that is, to blame them for not being careful and guarding their gods, and they said, Indeed, you are the wrongdoers, that is, for leaving them neglected and without a guardian, Then they lowered their heads, that is, then they looked down at the ground and said, Indeed, you know that these do not speak. Qatada said: The people were overcome by a state of terrible confusion, and they said, Indeed, you know that these do not speak. Al-Suddi said, Then they lowered their heads, that is, in the trial. Ibn Zayd said: That is, in opinion, and the statement of Qatada is more apparent in meaning, because they only did that out of confusion and helplessness, and for this reason they said to him, You have certainly known that these do not speak, so how can you tell us to ask them if they speak, when you know that they do not speak? Then Abraham said to them when they admitted that, Do you then worship besides God that which can neither benefit you nor harm you? That is, if it does not speak and it neither benefits nor harms, then why do you worship it besides God? Fie upon you and upon what you worship besides God! Do you not reason? That is, do you not reflect on what you are in of misguidance and gross disbelief that only spreads to an ignorant, unjust, and wicked person? So he established the proof against them and made them adhere to it, and for this reason God Almighty said, And that was Our proof which We gave Abraham against his people Al-An’am 2:17.

21:68: When their argument was refuted and their weakness was revealed and the truth appeared and falsehood was repelled, they turned to using their king's power and said: Burn him and support your gods if you must do so. So they gathered a great deal of firewood. Al-Suddi said: Even if a woman was sick, she would vow that if she recovered, she would carry firewood for the fire of Abraham. Then they put him in a hole in the ground and set it on fire, and it produced great sparks and a high flame, the likes of which had never been lit before. They put Abraham, peace be upon him, in the pan of the catapult at the signal of a man from the Persian Arabs from the Kurds. Shuaib al-Jubba’i, whose name was Hayzan, said: So God caused the earth to swallow him up, and he will continue to sink into it until the Day of Resurrection. When they threw him down, he said: God is sufficient for me, and He is the best Disposer of affairs. As al-Bukhari narrated on the authority of Ibn Abbas, who said: God is sufficient for me, and He is the best Disposer of affairs. Abraham said it when he was thrown into the fire, and Muhammad, peace be upon them both, said it when they said: The people have gathered against you, so fear them. So it increased their faith, and they said: God is sufficient for us, and He is the best Disposer of affairs. Al-Hafiz Abu Ya'la narrated: Abu Hisham told us, Ishaq bin Sulayman told us, on the authority of Abu Ja'far, on the authority of Asim, on the authority of Abu Salih, on the authority of Abu Hurayrah, who said: The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: "When Ibrahim, peace be upon him, was thrown into the fire, he said: O God, You are One in the heavens, and I am One on the earth, I worship You." It is narrated that when they began to tie him up, he said: There is no god but You, glory be to You, to You is praise, and to You is dominion, You have no partner. Shu'ayb al-Jubba'i said: He was sixteen years old at that time, and God knows best. 21:71: God Almighty says, informing about Abraham that God saved him from the fire of his people and brought him out from among them, migrating to the land of the Levant, to the Holy Land of it. As Al-Rabi' bin Anas said on the authority of Abu Al-Aaliyah, on the authority of Abu bin Ka'b in his saying: To the land which We have blessed for the worlds he said: The Levant and there is no fresh water except that it comes out from under the rock, and Abu Al-Aaliyah also said the same. Qatada said: He was in the land of Iraq, then God saved him to the Levant, and it was said that the Levant is the pillar of the house of migration, and whatever land was missing was added to the Levant, and whatever was missing from the Levant was added to Palestine, and it was said: It is the land of the gathering and the resurrection, and in it Jesus son of Mary, peace be upon him, will descend, and in it the Antichrist will perish. Ka'b al-Ahbar said about His statement: To the land which We have blessed for the worlds to Harran. Al-Suddi said: Abraham and Lot set out towards Ash-Sham, and Abraham met Sarah, the daughter of the king of Harran, who had criticized her people for their religion, so he married her on the condition that he would not change her. This was narrated by Ibn Jarir, and it is strange. What is well-known is that she was his cousin, and that he emigrated with her from his country. Al-Awfi said on the authority of Ibn Abbas: To Mecca. Do you not hear His statement: "Indeed, the first House [of worship] established for mankind was that at Makkah - blessed and a guidance for the worlds. In it are clear signs - the station of Abraham. And whoever enters it shall be safe." And His statement: And We bestowed upon him Isaac and Jacob as an additional gift. Ata’, Mujahid and Atiyyah said: Ibn Abbas, Qatadah and Al-Hakam bin Uyaynah said: The additional gift is the son of a son, meaning that Jacob gave birth to Isaac, as He said: So We gave her good tidings of Isaac, and after Isaac, Jacob. Abd Al-Rahman bin Zaid bin Aslam said: He asked for one, and said: My Lord, grant me from among the righteous. So God gave him Isaac and added to him Jacob as an additional gift. And all of them We made righteous, meaning all of them were people of goodness and righteousness. And We made them leaders, meaning they were followed, guiding by Our command, meaning they called to God with His permission. That is why He said: And We inspired in them the doing of good deeds, establishing prayer, and giving zakah, as a way of connecting the specific to the general. And they were worshippers of Us, meaning they did what they commanded people to do. Then He connected by mentioning Lot, who is Lot bin Haran bin Azar. He had believed in Abraham, peace be upon him, followed him and migrated with him, as God Almighty said: So Lot believed in him and said, ‘Indeed, I am emigrating to my Lord.’ So God gave him wisdom and knowledge, inspired him and made him a prophet and sent him to Sodom and its towns. They disobeyed him and denied him, so God destroyed them and ruined them, as He related their story in more than one place in His Noble Book. That is why He said: “And We saved him from the town that was doing evil deeds. Indeed, they were a wicked, wicked people. And We admitted him into Our mercy. Indeed, he was of the righteous.”

They disobeyed him and denied him, so God destroyed them and ruined them, as He related their story in more than one place in His Noble Book. That is why He said: “And We saved him from the town that was doing evil deeds. Indeed, they were a wicked, wicked people. And We admitted him into Our mercy. Indeed, he was of the righteous.”
21:76: God Almighty tells us about His response to His servant and messenger Noah, peace be upon him, when he called upon his people when they denied him, So he called upon his Lord, ‘Indeed, I am overcome, so help.’ “And Noah said, ‘My Lord, leave not upon the earth from among the disbelievers a single inhabitant. If You leave them, they will mislead Your servants and will not give birth to anyone but wicked disbelievers.’” That is why He said here, When he called before, We responded to him and saved him and his family, meaning those who believed in him, as He said, And his family, except for those against whom the word had gone forth and those who believed. But none believed with him except a few. And his saying: From the great distress means from the hardship, denial and harm, for he remained among them for a thousand years minus fifty years calling them to God Almighty, but only a few of them believed in him, and they would confront his harm and advise each other century after century and generation after generation to oppose him. And his saying: And We gave him victory over the people means We saved him and delivered him victorious from the people “who denied Our signs. Indeed, they were an evil people, so We drowned them all” meaning God destroyed them all, and not one of them remained on the face of the earth, as their prophet had called upon them.
